# JellyGlance
**Your Jellyfin command center** — live sessions, libraries, stats, calendars, requests, downloads, webhooks, and backups in one sharp dashboard.
Sits **beside** Jellyfin. Not a Seerr, Sonarr, or Jellyfin admin replacement.
---
### Why Unraid users install it - See who is watching and what is playing **right now** - Browse recently added, libraries, and activity without hopping apps - Calendar for Sonarr / Radarr / Lidarr releases - Optional Jellyseerr/Overseerr requests, download queues, Tdarr transcodes - First-run wizard: connect Jellyfin, sync, done
### Templates in this repo | Template | What it is | | --- | --- | | **jellyglance** | The app — `ghcr.io/nerdy-technician/jellyglance` | | **jellyglance-db** | Postgres 16 companion (skip if you already have Postgres) |
### Install in 3 steps 1. Create a **custom Docker network**; install **jellyglance-db** (or point at existing Postgres). 2. Install **jellyglance** on the same network — matching `POSTGRES_*` plus a strong `JWT_SECRET`. 3. Open the WebUI, then finish the first-run wizard (Jellyfin URL and API key).
**Site:** [jellyglance.com](https://jellyglance.com/) · **Project:** [GitHub](https://github.com/Nerdy-Technician/JellyGlance) · **Support:** [Issues](https://github.com/Nerdy-Technician/JellyGlance/issues)
